title: Stat-odometer — 4 mechanics per step (Springs)
source: springs.estate wellness stat block. Engine = library/components/stat-odometer (proven). Dual wrapper adds forceMotion + manualDrive + mobile auto-slider.
engine: A pinned stat-card slider — 4 mechanics per step at once (bg vertical slide-up + card-photo crossfade + numeral odometer-roll + label swap). Pure render(prog) drives all four off a single 0..1.
differs: CORRECTED (S19g vs D_SPRINGS_video, was the audit's only BAD): springs mobile stat = PINNED-SCROLL, not auto-slider. BOTH platforms scroll-pin drive the same 4-mechanic render(prog); difference = LAYOUT + pin-length (desktop wide; mobile full-bleed sticky, mechanics advance by scroll-progress = T-PIN-RUNSCENE). NOT scroll-vs-time.

desktop.driver: scrollStep — prog = scroll progress across the pin span (N-1 handoffs, reversible).

mobile.driver: scrollStep too — same pinned-scroll; stat sticks full-bleed and the 4 mechanics advance by scroll-progress (no timer).

holdMs.what: how long each step rests before advancing.

moveMs.what: the ease duration between two steps.

engine_patch: forceMotion (skip <=820px static guard) + manualDrive (expose render() WITHOUT engine ScrollTrigger/pin; also skips its Lenis, guards registerPlugin/ticker so it runs with no ScrollTrigger loaded). Additive & opt-in; default desktop behavior unchanged. See memory dual-platform-forcemotion.
entry: StatOdometerDual.init(target, opts) -> { platform, engine, driver, count }. Load engine.js THEN component.js. Markup: .so-stage > .so-bg + content(.so-num-window>.so-num-col, .so-label, .so-progress) + .so-step[data-num,data-label,data-bg] children.
law: render(prog) PURE; transform (bg slide, numeral roll) + opacity (photo/label crossfade) only; GPU; NO mix-blend/backdrop over the scrubbed surface; NO WebGL. reduced-motion → rest on last step.
